rounds_details: Round 1: Online Assessment (Aptitude + Logical Reasoning + DSA coding, HackerRank, 90 min). Round 2: Technical Interview (System Design LLD/HLD, projects, data structures). Round 3: Managerial/HR (Behavioural questions, scenarios, Why TCS?).
preparation_tips: Prepare core DSA (arrays, strings, hash maps), basic database queries, and be ready to explain your projects in depth.

rounds_details: Round 1: Online Test (Pseudo-code, math, verbal, puzzle, DSA). Round 2: Technical Interview (Java, OOPs, DBMS). Round 3: HR Round (general discussion, bond compliance).
preparation_tips: Focus heavily on Java, Object Oriented Design principles, database schema design, and basic algorithms.

rounds_details: Round 1: OA (Coding questions + work style assessment). Round 2: Technical 1 (DSA + LLD). Round 3: Technical 2 (Advanced DSA + HLD). Round 4: Bar Raiser (Leadership principles + system design).
preparation_tips: Master trees, graphs, dynamic programming, Low-Level Design (LLD) principles, and Amazon's 16 Leadership Principles.

rounds_details: Round 1: OA (DSA coding). Round 2: Technical 1 (Algorithms, Python). Round 3: Technical 2 (Algorithms, Python). Round 4: Technical 3 (Advanced Graph/Dynamic Programming). Round 5: Googliness & Leadership (behavioral).
preparation_tips: Solve highly complex graph, tree, and dynamic programming questions in Python or C++. Emphasize clean code, time complexity, and edge case checking.

rounds_details: Round 1: OA (2 coding questions). Round 2: Technical 1 (Trees & Graphs). Round 3: Technical 2 (System design & OS concurrency). Round 4: Technical 3 / Managerial (Design patterns, culture fit).
preparation_tips: Focus on Trees, Graphs, OS concepts (multithreading, deadlocks, virtual memory), and DBMS (indexing, B-trees, normalization).
